title: The multi report table prints no dedup_hits, claim_refused, asks_answered or wasted_tokens, so a recorded coord measurement is invisible in benchmarks.md
goal: benchmarks.py report lists dedup_hits, claim_refused, asks_answered and wasted_tokens of the multi rows beside dup_facts, claims and claim_conflicts (bench_report.MULTI_METRICS), so kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.md shows the coord shared against isolated figures that multi record wrote

run: import sys; t=open('kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.md',encoding='utf-8').read(); sys.exit(0 if 'dedup_hits' in t else 1)

repro_reason: the defect is a column the generated report omits; the only observable is the generated report's text, so the repro reads it after a report run
